instructions: Complete the tables below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

groups.context_line: You will hear a student asking an accommodation office what happens after a room in a hall of residence is offered.
groups.instructions: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

rows: a copy of the offer letter and (2) ........
the office emails the form to applicants
students travelling from abroad arrive earlier
kitchens are cleaned by staff every (4) ........
some noticeboards still show the old day

items.evidence: There's also a deposit of two hundred and fifty pounds, which you get back after the final inspection.
items.explanation: After explaining the rules for vacating the room, the advisor mentions a deposit of two hundred and fifty pounds; the money is returned after the final inspection.

items.prompt: a copy of the offer letter and (2) ........
items.evidence: A copy of your offer letter, and some photo identification
items.explanation: The student asks what to add to the form; the advisor asks for a copy of the offer letter and photo identification, giving a passport or driving licence as examples.

items.evidence: Move-in day is Saturday the fourteenth of September
items.explanation: The letter the student has says the 12th, but that date is the welcome programme for students arriving from abroad; move-in day for everyone else is 14 September.

items.prompt: kitchens are cleaned by staff every (4) ........
items.evidence: the cleaning moved to Thursdays last term
items.explanation: The published schedule and some noticeboards still say Wednesday; the advisor says the cleaning moved to Thursdays last term.

groups.context_line: You will hear a woman telephoning a coach company about a bag she has left on board.
groups.instructions: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

rows: the coach left the bus station at (5) ........ pm
it got in later than it should have done
inside were boots, a camera and a set of keys with a (6) ........
the luggage tag is too faint to read
the office is now at the Canal Road depot
most people decide to come in

items.prompt: the coach left the bus station at (5) ........ pm
items.evidence: Twenty past four from the bus station.
items.explanation: The passenger gives the departure time as "twenty past four"; the arrival time (a quarter to six) is separate information — the departure time is what is asked for.

items.prompt: inside were boots, a camera and a set of keys with a (6) ........
items.evidence: Oh, and a set of keys with a wooden fob.
items.explanation: As the contents of the bag are listed, the keys are added last; the key fob is clearly said to be wooden.

items.evidence: The reference is M for Marchwood, then two, oh, seven, four.
items.explanation: The clerk gives the reference by letter name and then digit by digit: M, followed by two-oh-seven-four.

items.evidence: for a rucksack that size it's twelve pounds
items.explanation: When the woman asks for the bag to be posted, the clerk says a rucksack that size costs twelve pounds.

groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about food grown inside cities.
groups.instructions: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

rows: commercial rooftop farms were rare: fewer than one city in (9) ........ had one
but individually far larger — the biggest covered a hectare and a half
the long-standing claim was up to (10) ........ times a field’s output per square metre
for staples such as wheat and potatoes the urban advantage disappears entirely
(11) ........ was placed last by the gardeners questioned
exercise came second in this study

items.prompt: commercial rooftop farms were rare: fewer than one city in (9) ........ had one
items.evidence: fewer than one city in five had a commercial one
items.explanation: In the survey of forty-one cities, fewer than one city in five had a commercial rooftop farm, though the ones that existed were much larger than a community garden.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Kor olcumde 3/3 bilindi: kiralik parsel sayisinin savas yillarinda zirve yaptigi genel kultur; senaryodaki '1950'ler' rakibi yanlis yone isaret ettigi icin ise yaramiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1. Tablo satiri degistirildi: 'Tarih' satiri yerine 'Anket' satiri kondu, bosluk tur 3'teki L1-S4-11'e kaydirildi. Ayrica eski satirin Detay hucresi ('the total then fell for fifty years') ayni alistirma paketindeki kisa cevap #1'in cevabini duz yaziyordu; o sizinti da bu degisiklikle kapandi.

items.prompt: the long-standing claim was up to (10) ........ times a field’s output per square metre
items.evidence: a well-run urban plot produces up to fifteen times as much per square metre as a conventional field
items.explanation: For years it was said that a well-run urban plot yields up to fifteen times as much per square metre as a field; more careful work puts the realistic figure far lower, and only for salad crops and soft fruit.

yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Satirin Detay hucresi ('stacked trays indoors under lamps') 'vertical farming' tanimini duz veriyordu; bosluk sesi hic gerektirmiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 1. Bosluk tur 4'e kaydirildi (yeni cevap noktasi L1-S4-31): yillarca tekrarlanan 'on bes kat' iddiasi. Duzeltilmis rakam (uc kat) L1 not tamamlama #31-36 setindeki sinav kalemi #34'un cevabi oldugu icin tablonun Detay hucresinde ANILMADI.

items.prompt: (11) ........ was placed last by the gardeners questioned
items.evidence: Saving money, interestingly, came bottom of the list.
items.explanation: As the benefits named by participants are listed, saving money is said to come at the bottom of the list.

groups.context_line: You will hear a man joining a leisure centre and asking about membership.
groups.instructions: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

rows: weekdays only; full membership costs more
students and the over-65s pay (13) ........ less
the usual £20 joining fee is not charged this month
an instructor sets up a programme on the machines
three hours of free parking if you enter your registration

items.explanation: The advisor gives the two membership types one after another; what is asked for is the monthly fee for the off-peak membership, not the full one.

items.prompt: students and the over-65s pay (13) ........ less
items.evidence: students and anyone over sixty-five get a fifth off
items.explanation: While explaining why he asks whether the man is a student, the advisor says students and the over-65s get a fifth off.

items.evidence: I could do Friday at quarter to seven
items.explanation: The man first asks for Thursday evening, but it is full; the quarter-to-seven appointment is given for Friday instead.
The advisor says the lockers no longer take coins, and members set their own code.
